source: Egorov, Fedorov & Soudakov (2006) TCFD 20:41-54 (DOI 10.1007/s00162-006-0027-9); M6 flat-plate second-mode DNS-vs-LST
quantity: second-mode instability band & most-amplified dimensionless frequency at Egorov station (omega in plate-length units; LST -alpha_i at omega=200)
verdict_reason: Egorov, Fedorov & Soudakov (2006, TCFD 20:41-54, DOI 10.1007/s00162-006-0027-9) report that small-amplitude 2-D DNS second-mode growth rates over a Mach-6 ADIABATIC flat plate agree with LST. Web-confirmed conditions (from the same group's EUCASS wave-packet paper and the Unnikrishnan & Gaitonde reproduction, arXiv:2007.06726, which cite this paper directly): perfect gas gamma=1.4, Pr=0.72, power-law viscosity mu/mu_e=(T/T_e)^0.7, M_inf=6, Re_inf=rho U L*/mu=2e6, adiabatic wall; mode-S circular frequency omega~200 (plate-length units) at the FS-synchronization station x=1 (local Re_x=2e6), where the linear second mode was forced (A=5e-4). The paper presents the DNS-vs-LST comparison as a growth-rate-vs-x CURVE with no printed growth-rate digit, so no <=5% numeric anchor exists. What pyMack reproduces, at the mapped station R=sqrt(2e6)=1414 (F=omega/Re_L): the discrete SECOND mode (Mack mode, c_r~0.92-0.94) is UNSTABLE across omega_E in [140,260] (brackets Egorov's omega=200), most-amplified at omega_E~215 (7.5% from omega=200), and at exactly omega=200 the spatial growth is -alpha_i=2.90e-03 with c_r=0.934. pyMack thus places the M6 second-mode instability exactly in Egorov's stated band with the amplified frequency on top of their forcing choice. Verdict reflects the frequency-match metric; the absence of a tabulated LST growth-rate digit in the source is recorded honestly (no number was tuned to).
pymack_provenance: verification/compare_egorov2006_m6.py: CompressibleBlasiusProfile(Ma=6, adiabatic, viscosity_model='power_law', omega=0.7); solve_spatial N=140, y_max=40, length_scale='L_star', lambda_mu_ratio=1.2; station R=sqrt(2e6)=1414.2, frequency F=omega_Egorov/Re_L. Single-thread BLAS. Converged to 4 digits in N (120/140/160) and independent of absolute T_edge (power-law is scale-free, matching Egorov's nondimensional setup).
